name: TOB Communication Campaign
description: One row per admin-initiated Communication Center campaign (Push/Email/WhatsApp, single/selected/all-eligible audience) — see COMMUNICATION_CENTER_API_CONTRACT.md. Deliberately separate from TOB Notification Template/the automated engine (Decision 5): this is an ad-hoc, admin-confirmed send, not an event-driven one. Status/audience_type/channel content fields store the exact wire-format values the Flutter client and this contract use directly (e.g. 'ALL_ELIGIBLE_USERS', 'PARTIALLY_SENT') rather than a friendlier Desk label, to eliminate a translation-layer bug source between backend and client.

fields.label: Status
fields.options:
DRAFT
SCHEDULED
QUEUED
PROCESSING
PARTIALLY_SENT
COMPLETED
FAILED
CANCELLED

fields.label: Audience User IDs (JSON)
fields.description: JSON array of user emails as submitted at creation time. Only meaningful for SINGLE_USER/SELECTED_USERS — the actual, snapshotted recipient list lives in TOB Communication Campaign Recipient, not here.

fields.label: Push Image URL
fields.description: Optional. A hosted image URL — reuses notifications/delivery.py's existing `image` parameter (already used by the automated engine's FCM sends), not a new upload mechanism. No file upload endpoint exists in this app, so v1 takes a URL the admin already has, matching the same simplicity principle as WhatsApp templates using an admin-picked existing template rather than inventing new infrastructure. Small Text, not Data — a Data (VARCHAR(140)) column silently truncated real-world URLs (e.g. Google's cached-image URLs routinely exceed 140 characters), confirmed live on a real device before this fix.

fields.label: Push Deep Link Route
fields.description: Optional. A route from the Flutter app's deepLink_routes.dart (e.g. '/dashboard', '/todayVerse') — reuses delivery.py's existing `route` parameter. No per-recipient ID param is supported (contract keeps campaigns audience-wide, not tied to one entity like a quiz/ticket).

fields.label: WhatsApp Template Name
fields.description: An APPROVED template name on the configured Chatwoot inbox (see communication/chatwoot.py's list_templates). Campaigns must use a template, never free text — a campaign recipient may never have messaged first, so WhatsApp's 24-hour free-text window cannot be assumed open.

fields.label: WhatsApp Template Params (JSON)
fields.description: JSON array of strings substituted into the template's numbered {{1}}, {{2}}, ... placeholders, in order — the same values for every recipient (v1 does not support per-recipient personalization of template params).
